comments.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
comments.body:
Ok so immediately on the first try there are some glaring issues. On PC the text is quite literally ant sized, it's nearly impossible to read. The sprite work is great, but you can't tell which way you're facing, there's no "back turned" version of the sprite. I also got stuck in the bottom corner of the screen somehow, and couldn't move out, I was holding W and still attacking down.

Seems like a fun game, but you need to do a lot of optimising
